messages:
sara: Nightly evals showing a spike in timeouts for the quantized sampling suite — ~15% failures across the last two runs. Anyone seen this?

maria: Yep, same. Failing ones are all during sampling, timeouts at 300s. Logs show workers going into an "idle backoff" and sleeping for long stretches.

aj: Link to one of the failing jobs?

sara: https://ci.redwood/teams/nightly/jobs/5123 — look at the quantized-sampling stage.

maria: Snippet from worker log attached below:

```
2026-03-18T02:04:12Z worker-7 INFO entering idle backoff loop: sleeping 120s (reason=workload-starvation)
2026-03-18T02:06:40Z worker-7 WARN woke up, processing request id=abc123
2026-03-18T02:10:00Z harness ERROR timeout waiting for sample (elapsed=310s, timeout=300s)
```

nate: That "idle backoff" was introduced in PR #4382 to reduce busy-loop CPU when the harness is starved. Looks like the implementation uses time.sleep which blocks the worker thread and races with shutdown/signals. Commit ab12cd34.

aj: Can you reproduce locally? I can try a quick revert if it's urgent.

maria: Repro is easy with the env flag we added. Run: `HARNESS_IDLE_BACKOFF=1 pytest tests/eval_harness/test_sleepy_workers.py::test_long_tail -k quantized` — I get consistent long-tail sleeps that trigger the harness timeout. I'll push a minimal reproducer in a sec.

eval-bot: nightly-job-5123: quantized-sampling stage failed — 23/150 timed out (see job details).

sara: Ok, plan: @aj can you open a rollback for the idle-backoff change for the nightly branch? @maria please prepare an event-driven fix (use Condition/Event instead of time.sleep) and a unit test.

aj: On it, opening PR now. Will target nightly branch and include test to ensure worker wake semantics.

aj: https://github.com/redwood-inference/harness/pull/4390 — revert idle-backoff implementation. Please review.

ci-bot: deploy started for pr/4390 -> target: nightly-runner-3 :rocket:

maria: After revert lands, I'll run 3 quick nightlies locally and post pass/fail. Also adding a small integration test that simulates burst work so we don't regress again.

nate: Also adding a metric for worker-blocked-time so we can alert on long sleeps in prod. Will follow up in infra ticket.

sara: Thanks all. Follow-up: create a short postmortem note in the eval-harness repo with root cause (time.sleep backoff -> sleepable worker -> timeout) and the fix path. Assigning to @maria for the fix and @aj for the rollback/CI patch. :eyes:

maria: ACK, filing the issue and the test now.

aj: Rolling rollback through the pipeline, will update when PR merges.

sara: Closing thread for now, will re-open if we see persistent flakiness after the deploy.
